name: Are off-market luxury condos more expensive?

mainEntity.name: Are off-market luxury condos more expensive?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing of off-market luxury condos can vary significantly and is not inherently higher or lower than publicly listed properties. While some sellers might price properties at a premium due to exclusivity, others may offer a more competitive price for a quick, discreet sale. The lack of public market comparables can make valuation more nuanced. A practical tradeoff for buyers is that while you might find unique value, negotiation often relies more heavily on your agent's expertise and market insight rather than publicly available data.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pricing for off-market luxury condos isn't uniformly higher or lower. Negotiation relies heavily on agent expertise due to limited public data.
